result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the status bar, header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible, with no overlapping or misplaced elements. The only visual concern is low-contrast secondary text. The clipped chips, carousel items, and bottom card were excluded as intentional scroll affordances.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the delivery fees (e.g., '€0.90 delivery'), the rating count '(500+)', and the light gray placeholder in the search bar appears to be light gray on white, which may fall below recommended WCAG contrast ratios.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text (e.g., to around #6B6B6B or darker on white) to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
